exposure: Cerebrovascular autoregulation (CAR) assessed using heart rate (HR/TOHRx)
Cerebrovascular autoregulation (CAR) assessed using mean arterial blood pressure (MABP/COx)
outcome: Cerebrovascular autoregulation (CAR) assessment (moving window correlation-coefficient with cerebral oxygenation saturation (rcSO2))
Percentage of time with impaired CAR (%timeCARi)
cohort: The study included 32 preterm infants with a median gestational age of 25 + 5/7 weeks (interquartile range 24 + 6/7-27 + 5/7).
finding: Heart rate and mean arterial blood pressure do not seem interchangeable when assessing cerebrovascular autoregulation in preterm infants, and neither method was associated with early cerebral injury.
